items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I heard the name but I never met him.

ctx.x: I heard the name but I never met him. I think he came later if I'm not mistaken. Some of those names, you know, will not sound familiar to me.
What about the McKinney family? Harold McKinney?
Well, there was a band called the McKinney Cotton Pickers. Is that what you're talking about?
